gloss_en: "the pride of Yaakov" (ge'on Yaakov) — the scriptural phrase from Psalms 47:5 ("He chooses our heritage for us, the pride of Yaakov whom He loves"), interpreted in LM 1:6 as the aspect of kingship/appointing a king over Israel (linked to "a star shall shoot forth from Yaakov"); not ga'on in the sense of a Torah sage or of arrogance
